    """Additional validation when following the implicit flow.
    """
    request_info = super().openid_authorization_validator(request)
    if request_info is None:
        # Base class returned None (pass), so we need to do our own validation
        # Check if this is an OpenID Connect request
        if not request.scopes or 'openid' not in request.scopes:

            request=request,
            description='Request is missing mandatory nonce parameter.'
